tags.name: Secure Remote Commerce
tags.description: Enable partners  to securely add, manage, and use Visa tokenized credentials for digital purchases built on EMV standards.

post.description:
The Identity Lookup operation uses a provided consumer identity (email address or mobile
phone number) to determine whether it is associated with an SRC profile.

**Authentication Requirements:**
- HTTP Header: x-pay-token - JWT token for authentication
- Query Parameter: apikey - API key issued during onboarding

srcClientId.description:
This is the ID shared by the SRC system with the client that identifies the connecting
client, such as SRCi, DCF, or SRC Issuer (SRCPI). If an API key was provided, use the API key as the srcClientId.

200.description: The operation is processed successfully, and the lookup result is included in the response body.

consumerStatus.description: Status of the consumer. Must be provided if the specified consumer identity was recognized by the SRC system.

consumerPresent1.description: Indicates whether the Identity Lookup operation was successful.

idLookupSessionId.description:
Session identifier of format UUID, returned by SRC System following an Identity Lookup operation. Can be used in subsequent Initiate Identity Validation operation.
Not supported in Visa SRC system.

lastUsedCardTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the last used card. UTC time in Unix epoch format.

post.description:
The Prepare SRC Profile operation requests that an SRC System prepare one or more SRC Profile(s) to be returned.

**Authentication Requirements:**
- HTTP Header: x-pay-token - JWT token for authentication
- Query Parameter: apiKey - API key issued during onboarding

idTokens.description:
(Conditional) List of JWTs. Either idTokens or consumerIdentities must be provided.
If both are provided, the idTokens will be used.

srcDpaId.description: DPA identifier, which is generated by the SRCI during DPA registration.

srcClientId.description:
This is the ID shared by the SRC system to the Client that identifies the connecting
client, e.g. SRCi, DCF, or SRC Issuer (SRCPI). If an API key was provided then use the API Key as the srcClientId.

srcCorrelationId.description:
(Conditional) Unique identifier generated by an SRC System. Must be provided if available within the present checkout session
(such as received in an earlier response during the present session), otherwise a new checkout session will be initiated.

srciTransactionId.description: A unique transaction ID created by the SRCi, which may be created on the merchant page. It must be passed through to all networks (SRC systems) and DCFs.

consumerIdentities.description:
(Conditional) List of Consumer Identities. Either idTokens or consumerIdentities must be provided.
If both are provided, the idTokens will be used.

schema.description:
### Request Body Validation Rules
#### idTokens/consumerIdentities Validation
- Either idTokens or consumerIdentities must be provided if:
- The idTokens list carries one or more Federated ID Tokens (used to identify associated SRC Profile(s), and attest that the requester is authorised to access this data). When the SRC Initiator performs Consumer Identity validation, it shall always use the Federated ID Token it generates here
- The consumerIdentities list carries one or more Consumer Identities and is used to identify associated SRC Profile(s) (may be used only when the client is trusted and authorised to access the SRC System)

200.description: The operation is processed successfully and the SRC Profile details are included in the response body

profiles.description: Contains entries if one or more SRC Profiles are found, otherwise an empty list is returned.

Unique identifier generated by an SRC System. Must be provided if available within the present checkout session
(such as received in an earlier response during the present session), otherwise a new checkout session will be initiated.

post.description:
The Card Enrolment operation enrols a Consumer and Digital Card (associated with an
underlying PAN) to a new SRC Profile, or adds a Digital Card to an existing SRC Profile.

client, such as SRCi, DCF, or SRC Issuer (SRCPI). If an API key was provided, then use the API key as the srcClientId.

encryptedCard.description:
(Conditional) URL-safe base64 encoded JWE<Card> information related to the Card being enrolled, with no padding.
Encrypted according to the JSON Web Encryption (JWE) specification RFC 7516, and the algorithm used for encryption is according to RFC 7518, Section 4.1.
Exactly one of encryptedCard or enrollmentReferenceData must be provided.

post.description:
The Initiate Identity Validation operation initiates a process to validate that a Consumer is in
the possession of, or has access to, the Consumer Identity claimed..

**Authentication Requirements:**
- HTTP Header: x-pay-token - JWT token for authentication
- Query Parameter: apiKey - API key issued during onboarding

srcClientId.description:
This is the ID shared by the SRC system to the Client that identifies the connecting
client, e.g. SRCi, DCF, or SRC Issuer (SRCPI). If an API key was provided then use the API Key as the srcClientId.

consumerIdentity.description:
(Conditional) Consumer identity information. One of consumerIdentity or idLookupSessionId must be provided.
If both are provided, idLookupSessionId takes precedence.

idLookupSessionId.description:
(Conditional) Session identifier of format UUID, returned by SRC System following an Identity Lookup operation. Can be used in subsequent Initiate Identity Validation operation. 
One of consumerIdentity or idLookupSessionId must be provided. If both are provided, idLookupSessionId takes precedence.

identity validation process, is valid. It can also be used to check whether an out-of-band service was successful.

**Authentication Requirements:**
- HTTP Header: x-pay-token - JWT token for authentication
- Query Parameter: apiKey - API key issued during onboarding

srcClientId.description:

reason.description:
Error reason associated with the error detail
| Reason Code                 | Description                                                                          |
|---------------------------- |--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD      | A required field is missing in the request.                                          |
| INVALID_IDENTITY_TYPE       | The identity type provided is invalid.                                               |
| INVALID_EMAIL_FORMAT        | The email address format is invalid.                                                 |
| INVALID_PHONE_FORMAT        | The phone number format is invalid.                                                  |
| INVALID_IDENTITY_PROVIDER   | The identity provider is invalid.                                                    |
| EMPTY_IDENTITY_VALUE        | The identity value is empty.                                                         |
| MISSING_CONDITIONAL_FIELD   | A field required under certain conditions is missing in the request.                 |
| CONSUMER_IDENTITY_NOT_FOUND | The specified consumer identity was not found.                                       |
| SESSION_ID_NOT_FOUND        | The specified session ID was not found.                                              |
| INVALID_VALIDATION_DATA     | The validation data provided is invalid.                                             |
| EMPTY_VALIDATION_DATA       | The validation data provided is empty.                                               |
| INCORRECT_OTP               | The one-time password (OTP) provided is incorrect.                                   |
| EXPIRED_OTP                 | The one-time password (OTP) provided has expired.                                    |
| VALIDATION_SESSION_NOT_FOUND | The specified validation session ID was not found.                                  |
| MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED       | The maximum number of validation attempts has been exceeded.                         |
| VALIDATION_ALREADY_COMPLETED | The identity validation has already been completed for the specified session ID.    |
| VALIDATION_NOT_INITIATED    | The identity validation has not been initiated for the specified session ID.         |
| INVALID_JWT_FORMAT          | The format of the provided JWT is invalid.                                           |
| EMPTY_ARRAY                 | The provided array is empty.                                                         |
| INVALID_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT  | The transaction amount provided is invalid.                                          |
| INVALID_CURRENCY_CODE       | The currency code provided is invalid.                                               |
| SRC_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND       | The specified SRC profile was not found.                                             |
| INVALID_PAYLOAD_TYPE        | The payload type provided is invalid.                                                |
| INVALID_COUNTRY_CODE        | The country code provided is invalid.                                                |
| INVALID_BILLING_ADDRESS     | The billing address provided is invalid.                                             |
| DIGITAL_CARD_NOT_FOUND      | The specified digital card was not found.                                            |
| DPA_NOT_FOUND               | The specified DPA was not found.                                                     |
| CORRELATION_ID_NOT_FOUND    | The specified correlation ID was not found.                                          |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

encryptedPayload.description:
JWE<Payload> - SRC payload (as defined in the payload schema) encrypted for the specific recipient (without signing).

To use this field:
1. Decrypt the JWE using the recipient's private key according to RFC 7516.
2. Parse the resulting JSON as a payload object (see payload schema).

The decrypted payload will contain card or token data, shipping address, billing address, and other consumer information
based on the payloadTypeIndicator value.

Conditionality: Either encryptedSignedPayload or encryptedPayload must be present in the response.
See: #/components/schemas/Payload

ISO 4217 three - digit currency code

recurringExponent.description:
Minor units of currency as specified in the ISO 4217 currency exponent 
For example: USD = 2, JPY = 0

recurringFrequency.description:
Indicates the minimum number of days between authorisations for a recurring or instalment transaction from 1 to 9999 inclusive
Conditionality: Required when recurringInd.frequencyInd = 01

RecurringData.description: The data specific to a recurring transaction

dynamicData.description: Dynamic data generated using the dynamicDataType preference indicated in paymentOptions.

consumerFullName.description:
Consumer-provided full name.
Conditionality: Required when:
• The value of the relevant data element of type PayloadTypeIndicator is set to FULL or NON_PAYMENT, and
• A consumer name is available in the SRC profile, and
• A consumer name was requested (consumerNameRequested set to true).

consumerLastName.description:
Consumer-provided last name.
Conditionality: Required when:
• The value of the relevant data element of type PayloadTypeIndicator is set to FULL or NON_PAYMENT, and
• A consumer last name is available in the SRC profile, and
• A consumer name was requested (consumerNameRequested set to true).

consumerFirstName.description:
Consumer-provided first name.
Conditionality: Required when:
• The value of the relevant data element of type PayloadTypeIndicator is set to FULL or NON_PAYMENT, and
• A consumer first name is available in the SRC profile, and
• A consumer name was requested (consumerNameRequested set to true).

consumerNationalIdentifier.description: Consumer national identifier as available in the SRC profile.

Payload.description: The payload contains either a card or a token field, but never both, as they are mutually exclusive.

panBin.description: First significant digits of the PAN in unmasked form. Maximum length = PAN length - 10.

tokenId.description: Reference identifier for the payment token representing the PAN.

serviceId.description: Service identifier associated with the SRC digital card.

cofEligible.description: Indicates that the card is eligible for the merchant digital card-on-file use case.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Country code of issuance associated with the card issuer’s BIN license.

panLastFour.description: Last four digits of the PAN in unmasked form.

tokenBinRange.description:
Specific BIN range or subset of the BIN range designated only for issuing payment tokens in unmasked form.
Conditionality: Required when a payment token is used.
Maximum length = payment token length - 10.

tokenLastFour.description:
Last four digits of the payment token in unmasked form.
Conditionality: Required when a payment token is used.

srcPaymentCardId.description:
(Conditional) Reference identifier for the PAN that enables the SRC system to communicate with the SRCPI without transmitting the actual PAN. 
It is associated with the SRC profile to which the payment card belongs and is unique within an SRC system.
Conditionality: Required when returned to the SRCPI.

dateOfCardCreated.description: UTC time in Unix epoch format. Date when the card was enrolled into the SRC system.

panExpirationYear.description:
Expiration year expressed as a four-digit calendar year (YYYY) for presentation purposes.
Conditionality: Required when specified for the card (PAN).

dateOfCardLastUsed.description: UTC time in Unix epoch format. Date when the card was last used for an SRC transaction.

panExpirationMonth.description:
Expiration month expressed as a two-digit month (MM) for presentation purposes.
Conditionality: Required when specified for the card (PAN).

digitalCardFeatures.description: Attributes related to the digital card features that should be displayed to the consumer.

paymentCardDescriptor.description: A free-form string used for card brand or program recognition (also known as card short description). Example 'Visa Travel Rewards'

paymentAccountReference.description:
PAR - A non-financial reference assigned to each unique PAN.
Used to link a payment account represented by that PAN to affiliated payment tokens.

tokenExpirationYear.description:
Expiration year expressed as a four-digit calendar year (YYYY).
Conditionality: Required when specified for the payment token.

tokenExpirationMonth.description:
Expiration month expressed as a two-digit month (MM).
Conditionality: Required when specified for the payment token.

paymentAccountReference.description: A non-financial reference assigned to each unique PAN, used to link a payment account represented by that PAN to affiliated payment tokens.

windowType.description: (Optional) Preferred window type for the authentication method.

challengeIndicator.description:
(Optional) Challenge indicator value related to 3DS authentication. It is one of the following values:
 * 01 - No preference
 * 02 - No challenge requested
 * 03 - Challenge requested (3DS Requestor Preference)
 * 04 - Challenge requested (Mandate)
 * 05 - No challenge requested (transactional risk analysis is already performed)
 * 06 - No challenge requested (Data share only)
 * 07 - No challenge requested (strong consumer authentication is already performed)
 * 08 - No challenge requested (utilize trust list exemption if no challenge required)
 * 09 - Challenge requested (trust list prompt requested if challenge required)

paymentCardTypeSelected.description:
Identifies the cardholder selection to process the transaction as either debit or credit at checkout. 
Applicable only when the card product supports both credit and debit (Combo) options.
Format: It is one of the following values: CREDIT, DEBIT

CustomInputData.description:
Network Specific Custom Input Data.
Clients should silently disregard any unrecognized fields in the JSON object.

PayloadTypeIndicatorCheckout.description:
Identifies the type of encrypted payload to be returned.
Format: It is one of the following values: 
 * FULL — Includes everything; all PCI & PII data (card/token, billing, shipping, consumer)
 * PAYMENT — Includes everything; all PCI & PII data (card/token, billing, shipping, consumer)
 * NON_PAYMENT - Includes only PII data (shipping, billing, consumer); excludes card/token data
 * SUMMARY — (Default) Includes no PCI & PII data; only SRC Profile and transaction metadata

encryptedPayload.description:
JWE<Payload> - SRC payload (as defined in the payload schema) encrypted for the specific recipient (without signing).

To use this field:
1. Decrypt the JWE using the recipient's private key according to RFC 7516.
2. Parse the resulting JSON as a payload object (see payload schema).

The decrypted payload will contain card or token data, shipping address, billing address, and other consumer information
based on the payloadTypeIndicator value.

Conditionality: Either encryptedSignedPayload or encryptedPayload must be present in the response.
See: #/components/schemas/Payload

srcCorrelationId.description:
Unique identifier generated by an SRC system.
Conditionality:
• Required for the checkout.
• Required if received in the request.

srciTransactionId.description:
A unique transaction ID provided by the SRCi, which may be created on the merchant page. It must be passed through to all
networks (SRC systems) and DCFs.
Conditionality: Required when received in the request

CheckoutPayloadResponse-1.description: Checkout payload response containing transaction details and payment information.

dpaUri.description:
(Conditional) Specifies the browser origin of the merchant’s parent window. This value is used by the step‑up Application 
to ensure the authentication result is only delivered to the correct and trusted origin.

dpaPresentationName.description: Display name of the DPA. Required to facilitate transaction authentication.

identityType.description: (Required) Type of consumer identity transmitted or collected.

identityValue.description:
(Required) Consumer identity value that corresponds to the consumer identity type.
Format: String for a valid email address. For a mobile number, use the E.164 format with a maximum length of 15, including the country code. Remove special characters: All spaces, dashes, and parentheses should be removed, and all characters should be numeric. The mobile number must not include "+".
Example: user@example.com, 61423123456

identityProvider.description: (Optional) Identity provider of the Consumer Identity. The default value is SRC

idToken-1.description:
Federated idToken in JWT Format. The token is a JSON Web Token (JWT) compliant with RFC 7519 and signed
using JSON Web Signature (JWS). The API returns the compact serialized JWT string in this field. The decoded JWT structure is 
documented by FederatedIdTokenDecoded, FederatedIdTokenHeader and FederatedIdTokenClaims.
See: #/components/schemas/FederatedIdTokenDecoded

ServiceId.description: To indicate to the SRC System that the Digital Card is the merchant Digital Card-on-file or partner token.

alg.description:
Algorithm used to digitally sign the payload according to RFC 7518.
'none' is not supported. 'PS256' is preferred to 'RS256'.

kid.description: Key ID for the SRC System public key to be used to verify the signature.

typ.description: Media type of the token. For JWT tokens the value should be JWT+ext.id_token.

datePublished.description: Date the resource was published. UTC time in Unix epoch format.

checkoutEventType.description:
Event type associated with the confirmation. Valid values are:
• 00 Place Order
• 01 Authorise
• 02 Capture
• 03 Refund
• 04 Cancel (Auth Reversal)
• 05 Fraud
• 06 Chargeback
• 07 Cancel before Auth
• 08 Auth for account validation
• 09 - 50 EMVCo future use
• 51 - 99 SRC System specific

confirmationReason.description: Description of the reason for the event associated with the order

confirmationStatus.description:
Status related to the checkoutEventType as provided by the SRC Initiator. Valid values are:
• 01 Success
• 02 Failure
• 03 Other
• 04 Timeout

checkoutEventStatus.description:
Event status associated with the order. Valid values are:
• 01 Created
• 02 Confirmed
• 03 Cancelled
• 04 Fraud Cancelled
• 05 Others
• 06 - 50 EMVCo future use
• 51 - 99 SRC System specific

confirmationTimestamp.description: UTC time in Unix epoch format. Date and time of the event set by the SRC Initiator

paymentNetworkReference.description: Transaction identifier as provided by a Payment Network payment authorisation has been completed

networkAuthorizationCode.description:
(Conditional) Authorisation code associated with an approved transaction
Conditionality: Required when the value of:
• checkoutEventType is set to 01 (Authorize) or 03 (Refund); and
• confirmationStatus is set to 01 (Success)

networkTransactionIdentifier.description: Unique authorisation related tracing identifier assigned by a Payment Network and provided in an payment authorisation response

identityType.description: Type of consumer identity transmitted or collected.

identityProvider.description: Identity provider of the consumer identity.

maskedIdentityValue.description: Masked consumer identity value (for example, masked email address or masked mobile phone number).

eci.description:
(Optional) If present, a value indicating the result of the authentication performed or attempted during a transaction. 
Use this value in the e-commerce authorization message to VisaNet.
Format: String; maximum 2 digits. It is one of the following values:
05 - Successful authentication
06 - Authentication attempted
07 - Authentication not performed

verificationData.description: (Required) Verification data. Set of verification data structures relating to different types of assurance.

AssuranceData.description:
Set of verification data structures relating to different types of assurance. Includes information about any risk assessment operations performed by
the SRC system.

clientAppId.description:
(Conditional) Client Application Id, which identifies the wallet provider application.
Format: UUID, 36
Conditionality: Required for Token for Token use-case or deferred authentication flows.

PayloadTypeIndicator.description:
Identifies the type of encrypted payload to be returned.
Format: One of the following values: 
 * FULL — Includes all PCI and PII data (card or token, billing, shipping, consumer).

allowCall.description: Consumer's preference for receiving communications via voice calls.

allowPush.description: Consumer's preference for receiving communications via a notification channel.

allowText.description: Consumer's preference for receiving communications via SMS.

allowEmail.description: Consumer's preference for receiving communications via email.

complianceResources.description:
(Conditional) Compliance resources. 
Conditionality: Refer to country-specific regulations or requirements.

businessIdentificationType.description: Conditionality: Required when acquirerMerchantId is not present or when business Identification Value is present.

businessIdentificationValue.description: Conditionality: Required when acquirerMerchantId is not present or when businessIdentificationType is present.

reason.description:
Error reason associated with the HTTP status code are
| Reason Code                | Description                                                                          |
|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| INVALID_PARAMETER           | The value provided for one or more request parameters is considered invalid. This error is also generated in case of a missing, required, request parameter. |
| INVALID_REQUEST            | The server is not able to adequately parse the request. Usually occurs when some request parameter is expected to be in a particular format but is not. |
| NOT_FOUND                  | The requested resource/business entity does not exist. The resource might also be hidden for security reasons 
| AUTH_INVALID               | Invalid federated idToken                                                            |
| ACCT_INACCESSIBLE          | The account exists but is not currently accessible (e.g. is locked)                  |
| INTERNAL_ERROR             | Some error happened on the server which caused the error. Either show a generic message or retry the same request again (it might succeed). 
| SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE        | The service is currently unavailable. Retry after some time.                         |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

status.description: HTTP status code to categorize the errors.

message.description: Error message associated with the HTTP status code.

errorDetail.description: List of error details providing additional information about the error.

acquirerBin.description: Acquiring institution identification code as assigned by the DS receiving the AReq message.

merchantName.description: Merchant name assigned by the acquirer or payment system.

acquirerMerchantId.description: Acquirer-assigned merchant identifier. This may be the same value used in authorization requests sent on behalf of the 3DS requestor and is represented in ISO 8583 formatting requirements.

merchantCategoryCode.description: Describes the merchant’s type of business, product, or service (MCC).

DynamicDataType.description: Type of dynamic data required in the payload.

transactionAmount.description: Amount of the transaction represented as a floating-point number, with 9 digits for the integer part and 4 digits for the decimal part.

transactionCurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Currency in which the transaction amount is expressed.

dsTransId.description: (Optional) ID assigned by the DS to identify the transaction (for 3DS authentication).

acsTransId.description: (Optional) ID assigned by the ACS to identify the transaction (for 3DS authentication).

transStatus.description: (Optional) Indicates whether a transaction qualifies as an authenticated transaction (for 3DS authentication).

uriType.description: Type of the URI. Valid values are APP_URI and WEB_URI.

issuerIdentity.description:
Cardholder identity as known by the card issuer. This generally enables access to an application, website, or other resource. 
Examples include username, email address, or mobile number.

CardholderData.description: Cardholder information, which is required for token provisioning.

FederatedIdTokenDecoded.description:
Documentation-only schema representing the decoded JWT structure of the
Federated ID Token. The API does not return this object directly.

SrcDigitalCardId.description: Reference identifier for the digital card representing the PAN or payment token.

payloadRequested.description: Indicates whether the SRCI or Merchant prefers an authenticated or non-authenticated payload

authenticationMethods.description:
The list of authentication methods and associated parameters is populated by the SRCI:
• in its preferred order; or
• as instructed by the SRC System

countryCode.description:
(Required) Country code associated with the consumer phone number.
Format: The E.164 format includes the country code, local area code, and local phone number. No spaces: When adding the number as a contact, there should be no spaces. Remove special characters: All spaces, dashes, and parentheses should be removed, and all characters should be numeric. The country code must not include "+".

phoneNumber.description:
(Required) Phone number without the country code.
Format: The E.164 format. No spaces: When adding the number as a contact, there should be no spaces. Remove special characters: All spaces, dashes, and parentheses should be removed, and all characters should be numeric. For some countries, such as Australia, the leading “0” of the local number must be removed when converting to E.164. For example, “0423 123 456” becomes “61423123456.”
Minimum length = 4
Maximum length = 14, with the condition that the maximum length including the country code must not exceed 15 digits.
